request.style: English, Delta blues, raw male vocal, resonator slide guitar, stomp box, harmonica, sparse and haunting, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two brothers working the morning land
One with the flock and one with the plough in his hand
Abel brought the firstborn and the best of what he had
Cain brought his offering and his heart was turning bad
Am I my brother's keeper

[Verse]
The LORD looked kindly on Abel's gift, but Cain's he would not take
Cain's face fell and his anger burned like a fire he couldn't shake
Why so angry, said the LORD, if you do well, you'll rise
Sin is crouching at your door, but you must rule it inside
Am I my brother's keeper

[Verse]
Cain said to his brother, come walk with me a while
Out in the field where nobody could see, he hid it with a smile
He rose up against his brother out there by the old fig tree
And the morning land drank Abel's blood as quiet as could be
Am I my brother's keeper

[Verse]
The LORD said, where is Abel, Cain said, I do not know
What have you done, your brother's blood cries from the ground below
Cain went out a wanderer, the earth no longer his
But God put a mark on him, that's how mercy is
Am I my brother's keeper

[Outro]
Yes, I am my brother's keeper
Lord, make me my brother's keeper
